title_ru: Fallout 3 — F3DAD: аудит SCDA/SCRO/CTDA и статической достижимости world-ghost ссылок
title_en: Fallout 3 — F3DAD Compiled SCDA/SCRO/CTDA Static-Ghost Reachability Audit v1.3

new_detectors: Interpret SCRO as compiler-emitted reference presence, not as action direction.

Use active SCTX semantics to classify referenced objects as Enable targets, Disable targets, MoveTo destinations, PlaceAtMe anchors, PushActorAway targets, Activate targets or getSelf identity comparators.
Inspect SCDA presence as compiled-code evidence without pretending to perform a complete opcode-level decompilation.
Scan CTDA records for direct candidate FormID occurrences as a narrow negative/positive condition-reference check.
Resolve XESP opposite-of-parent children when the parent base script performs an active bare self Enable/Disable transition.
Compare orphan refs against spatially and semantically adjacent peers using the same base or encounter family.
Treat commented SCTX lines as development-history evidence but never as runtime actions.

methodology_corrections.finding: v1.2 missed bare script commands such as 'disable' that operate on the executing reference itself.

zeta_control_example.meaning: The parent can self-disable when triggered, making the opposite-state child statically reachable.

methodology_corrections.effect: Nine v1.2 NO_STATIC_ENABLE_PATH candidates are removed from the ghost tail.

methodology_corrections.finding: Five v1.2 SCRO-only ambiguous refs have active roles that do not require them to become visibly enabled.

reclassified_controls.boundary: The static graph proves script addressability; exact engine behavior of Activate on a disabled reference is not independently runtime-tested here.

intended_semantics_from_source: When executing while enabled, it PlaceAtMe-s GrenadePulseExplosion.
A 0.05 second timer then calls LinkRef1.Enable.

critical_attachment_audit.meaning: The cascade script survives as a separate SCPT record but is not wired to the marker objects in the shipped master.

findings.interpretation: The shipped master preserves three pieces of an abandoned minefield-chain design: a 16-node XLKR topology, a cascade script designed to explode and enable the next linked ref, and a minefield-switch source line that would enable the start marker. The prototype is dismantled in at least two places: the starter is commented and the cascade SCPT is unattached.
findings.correction_vs_intermediate_analysis: Do not describe this as a fully functional chain with only its starter disabled; the script attachment is absent in shipped Anchorage.esm.

public_footprint.indexed_search_note: The script names are publicly listed; this registry's contribution is the shipped-reference topology and attachment audit.

peer_comparators: 00096346 EnclaveCrateContainer01 has XESP to Camp02 marker while 00096347/00096348 do not.
0002320C EnclaveCrateContainer01 has XESP in Camp04 while 0007D02E does not.
00023237 WeapLaserRifle is XESP-parented in the Camp04 family while 0002323E is not.
0002323B and nearby bunker references share FFEnclaveEncampment04xmrk while 0002323E lacks that relation.
findings.interpretation: The recurrence across two Enclave camp layouts makes a one-off parser artifact unlikely. Static shipped topology is consistent with omitted enable-parent assignments or intentionally abandoned loot props.
findings.claim_boundary: Missing XESP and no discovered script path establish a strong static-world-ghost classification, not proof that no engine-side or save-state mechanism could ever expose the refs.

high_interest_unconnected_refs.note: Unnamed extra placement of the same shared-trigger base.

public_footprint.new_claim_scope: Reference-state/XESP comparison, not discovery of the script text or trigger names.

findings.interpretation: The master script still knows how to respond if these named refs fire, but the shipped static placement graph does not expose the same enable-parent connection used by many peer triggers. This is consistent with disconnected encounter branches or incomplete placement wiring.

shared_script.A_role: Disable A steam marker, unlock/open A doors.
shared_script.B_role: Toggle B jets/trap and door state.
shared_script.C_role: Disable C gas traps/steam and open C door.

related_trigger_logic_oddity.static_interpretation: Because the source sets timer exactly to 5, the >5 branch is false on the first subsequent GameMode evaluation under ordinary numeric semantics, so the ELSE trap-enable path appears immediately reachable.

public_footprint.new_claim_scope: Physical placement-state comparison A/B versus C and its reachability consequences, not discovery of the script text.

findings.interpretation: Retained as a lower-confidence world-ghost/legacy traversal candidate because no counterpart architecture has yet been reconstructed strongly enough to infer its intended role.

tail_policy.high_confidence_promotion_rule: Promote only when static unreachability is supported by multiple independent signals such as missing XESP, missing active Enable path, peer topology contrast, surviving functional branch, or commented/replaced implementation evidence.
excluded_or_downranked_classes: known cut content already documented publicly
objects with clear nonvisual positional/controller roles
objects for which a peer/revision comparator is not yet available

public_novelty_policy.admitted_claim: v1.3 independently reconstructs shipped reference topology, script attachment state, and static reachability relations from the registered F3DAD master set.

core_result_ru: После исправления логики XESP и направления SCRO мы получили более чистый слой цифровой археологии: девять ложных призраков сняты через self-disable родителей; пять SCRO-кандидатов объяснены как невидимые якоря/контроллеры; одновременно усилились четыре orphan-loot ссылки лагерей Анклава, три именованных отключённых encounter-trigger Liberty Prime и две подавленные gas-control ревизии Zeta. Самая необычная новая архитектура — 16-звенная XLKR-цепь мин Anchorage с отдельно сохранившимся cascade-script и закомментированным starter, причём shipped attachment cascade-script к marker-объектам отсутствует.

next_gate.goal: Search all shipped SCTX for commented Enable/Activate/SetStage/PlaceAtMe/FireWeapon entrypoints, then follow the referenced objects into live FormID graphs to find other dismantled systems analogous to the Anchorage mine cascade.
next_gate.reason: v1.3 shows that the strongest hidden mechanics can survive as a live topology plus dead/commented entrypoint or missing attachment rather than as a conventional cut item.
